style: Style: dark charcoal near-black background (#0A0C0F), brand teal-to-green gradient accents (#0EA6C9 through #16D27E), thin luminous line-work with soft glow, abstract geometric/financial motifs, generous negative space, flat and minimal, premium fintech. Absolutely no text, no letters, no numbers, no human faces, no logos, no brand names. Centered composition with dark margins.
